title: Al Boraq, Tangier and Casablanca gain connected local accounts
summary: One original railway corridor and two distinct municipal places connect intercity access with local transport, public space, service contracts and climate planning. Eligibility reaches 83 projects and 53 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Sixteen official French, Arabic and English HTML records inspected November 22 with traceable AI interpretation. Later railway orders, historical opening dates, partial-year use, parking rules and planned climate results retain their separate scopes.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
